title: Workshop: the Summary tab shows problems with their fixes first, as cards
story: The Workshop Summary tab now starts with the week's verdict and the problems with their fixes, as cards that follow the merged prototype; ideas and wins come after them. This replaces the Markdown summary (At a glance, What went well, Where things go wrong, Try this week) for new runs only. Past runs keep showing their old Markdown, and a summary that misses the shape shows the existing No summary message.

checks.criterion: The Summary tab shows a new run as cards: the This week verdict, then numbered problems with What, Why it matters and a green Fix box, then Ideas to try, then What went well; no buttons.
checks.steps: Open Maestro, open the Workshop panel, click Run now, wait for the run to finish, stay on the Summary tab.
checks.expected: A red-edged This week banner and at most 3 problems, ideas and wins, each section with a count. No buttons below the tabs.

checks.criterion: A section with no items is hidden, heading included.
checks.steps: Open a run whose summary has no ideas or no wins.
checks.expected: No heading for the missing section; the other sections drawn as normal.

checks.criterion: A run from before this change still shows its Markdown.
checks.steps: In the Workshop panel, pick an older run from Past runs.
checks.expected: The old At a glance style Markdown summary, unchanged.

checks.criterion: A summary call that fails or misses the shape keeps the report and says why.
checks.steps: Run the Workshop while the summary call cannot succeed, for example while signed out of Claude.
checks.expected: No summary for this run (reason). The Real Transcript tab still shows the report.
